settings.settings_source: circuit_heads: E62 (reports/analyses/2026-11-02_analysis_e62-copying-heads.md: (2,4) the copying head, (1,1) the top previous-token head, each alone takes W0's top-1 from 0.82 to about 0.01). slot_layer 0: the earliest MLP, so the slots act before both circuit heads read their inputs. Slots: E206's rule (smallest mean activation^2 x |output column|^2), here at layer 0. window, n_read, read_seed, pairs, counted, seeds: E196/E208's filed settings. lookup_bar 0.9: E206's graft held-out accuracy 0.924, rounded down. copy_bar_frac 0.8: the re-triggered copy must reach most of M's own copy rate (E62 base 0.8247); a measurement bar on the build, not on any reading. g_fallback_ratio 2.67: E196's largest twin/reuse MLP update ratio (case pair, experiments/rule_retention_pairs/results/update_size.json, 0.0200/0.0075). detector_ratio, detector_quantile, gamma_t_max: build checks set here, each logged with the value reached; none enters a reading. cue_seed, split_seed: new seeds.

thresholds.thresholds_source: tau, orders, order_seed, chunk, kl_floor, gate_tol: E208's filed values (experiments/rho_saved_items/results/predictions.json). e62_base, e62_tol, e62_ablated_bar: E62's filed a_heads rule (top-1 under H < 0.3, base within 0.01 of 0.8247). band_factor 3: the 3 s bar of E55's filed rules (src/commute/interchange.py), applied to the noise measured in stage 1. a_prime_copy_max: a build check that the new cue does not already trigger copying in M.

level.neuron: every MLP neuron, every attention head, the token embedding, the unembedding (E208's parts, commute.rho)
level.head: every attention head, each whole MLP layer, the embedding, the unembedding (E193's level B)
level.mlp_layer: each attention layer (its 6 heads), each MLP layer, the embedding, the unembedding
level.block: each block (its attention and MLP), the embedding, the unembedding
level.alignment: the identity on every cell, so the fit of the level on M and on F is 0 at every level; a coarse part's swap is the swap of all its cells

readings.r_u: 1 - KL(F || F with part u alone swapped) / KL(F || M), on D at the last position, signed, not clipped
readings.replace (reading A): a swapped part runs M's mechanism on the input it receives in the hybrid (the theory note's starred choice; commute.rho.forward with mrun None)
readings.patch (reading B): a swapped part takes the value it had in M's own run on the same window (Prakash et al. 2024; commute.rho.forward with mrun)
readings.K: per order, commute.rule_retention_fixed.eliminate over the level's changed parts, kept while 1 - KL(F || F_K) / KL(F || M) >= tau
readings.R: mean of r_u over K, per order; the item's R is the mean over the 5 orders. R is this test's summary, not the definition's score
readings.band: per level and reading: band_factor x the largest, over the four edits, of max(sd of R over the 5 orders, |R on windows half 1 - R on half 2|), the halves a seeded split (split_seed) of D into 256 + 256 windows; measured in stage 1 before stage 2 reads
readings.swap_floor: per edit and level: KL(M native || F with every changed part swapped) / KL(F || M), read in stage 1's gate

expected.do_nothing: no changed part at every level under both readings: reads 'no change'

reuse_small.neuron: about 1 - 1/8: exactly 1 - mean over K of each slot's share of KL

expected.rebuilt: reported at every level, not an anchor; no expected value scored
expected.derivation: plan appendix section 3: K holds only changed parts; a part holding the whole edit gives M on D when swapped, so r = 0

rules.R0 (stops): Stage 0 (do-nothing, alone): exit 1 unless do-nothing reads 'no change' at all four levels under both readings; F with nothing swapped matches F's native logits within gate_tol (max |diff| / max |logit|, as E208's gate); copying.induction top-1 on M within e62_tol of e62_base; and top-1 with (2,4) mean-ablated under e62_ablated_bar. Stage 1 (build): exit 1 if any edit's KL(F || M) on D <= kl_floor; reuse copy top-1 on D < copy_bar_frac x M's induction top-1; new lookup top-1 on D < lookup_bar; M's copy top-1 on D (A' in place of the second A) > a_prime_copy_max; gamma_T > gamma_t_max; or, at any level, F with every changed part swapped differs from M's native logits by more than gate_tol, or F with none swapped from F's by more than gate_tol. An empty K exits 1 (a code error).
rules.R1 (a level recovers the labels): for level l and reading x: recovers iff min(R(reuse_small), R(reuse_large)) - max(R(new_few), R(new_thin)) > band(l, x), strictly. Do-nothing is not part of the rule. Each of the 8 (level, reading) cells reads 'recovers' or 'does not'.
rules.R2 (the test's verdict): 'pass' iff R1 reads 'recovers' at one or more levels under replace (reading A); else 'fail'. The levels that pass are listed. Patch's R1 cells are reported beside it, and are not the verdict.
rules.P1: under replace, at head, mlp_layer and block: |R| <= max(3 x swap_floor of that edit and level, 0) for reuse_small, new_few and new_thin (an exact 0 when the swap is bitwise M), and R(reuse_large) above 3 x its swap_floor. Holds iff all 9 + 3 conditions hold.
rules.P2: under replace, at neuron: R(new_thin) >= 0.99 and R(new_thin) > max(R(reuse_small), R(reuse_large), R(new_few)), strictly. Holds iff both. This is the user's 'the neuron level misses the thinly spread new item'.
rules.P3: R2 reads 'fail' (no level passes, so run 2 does not run).
rules.P4: under patch: for every level, R_patch(reuse_small) <= R_replace(reuse_small) + band(l, patch); and R1 under patch reads 'does not' at every level. Holds iff both.
rules.run 2: only if R2 reads 'pass': the trained pairs (pairs, seeds) are read once at the passing level under replace (if several pass, the finest of them), on E196's read windows. Reported per item as R with its band and its K, with no label and no rule scored. The reuse member minus twin gap per pair and seed is reported beside the twin-over-reuse update ratio (E196's update_size.json).

edge_cases_checked.do_nothing: no changed part, so R undefined and the item reads 'no change'; R1 never takes it, so it cannot pass
edge_cases_checked.ties: R1 is strict; at coarse levels the band can be 0 (R exact), and 0 against 0 does not recover
edge_cases_checked.zero denominator: KL(F || M) <= kl_floor is a stage-1 stop, so r_u is never divided by zero
edge_cases_checked.empty K: impossible while KL(F || M) > kl_floor (F with every changed part swapped is M); a stop if seen
edge_cases_checked.negative r_u: kept signed; R1 compares signed values
edge_cases_checked.slot drops out of K: R over the K found; logged, not a stop
edge_cases_checked.g has no solution above 1: g_fallback_ratio applies; the size match is reported as not met
edge_cases_checked.several levels pass: run 2 reads the finest passing level; all passing levels are listed

blind_to.R: how much each part matters beyond the 0.1 of the behaviour tau leaves out; any unchanged part (clause 5 never puts one in K), so an unchanged circuit a re-trigger runs through is invisible under replace
blind_to.the edits: trained solutions; each edit is one site and one hand-built write, so it says what the reading does on known answers, not what trained fine-tunes do
blind_to.update size: matched only for reuse_large against the new edits (Frobenius norm, absolute); reuse_small and new_few share their input rows, and their output columns differ in size, logged

positive_control: Stage 0: M's induction top-1 0.8247 reproduced, and lost under (2,4)'s ablation (the circuit the reuse edits rely on exists). Stage 1: the all-swapped gate at each level (F with every changed part swapped is M).
noise_floor: the band (readings.band), measured in stage 1 on each level and reading; the swap_floor per edit and level
